articles.title: Labour councils turn on Sadiq Khan’s housing plans
articles.summary: Khan has revised downwards his affordable homes quota
articles.ai_summary:
- Labour councils oppose Sadiq Khan’s updated housing strategy, criticizing his reduced affordable homes target.  
- The backlash highlights tensions within the party over housing policy amid a rising demand for affordable living options.

articles.title: Council to “engage” with landlords over tougher rental enforcement
articles.summary: The council is run jointly by the Greens and Labour
articles.ai_summary:
- The council, led by a coalition of Greens and Labour, plans to collaborate with landlords to discuss stricter enforcement measures for rentals.  
- This initiative aims to address rental issues and enhance tenant protection within the community.

articles.title: Labour MP blames landlords’ rents for size of welfare budget
articles.summary: Margaret Mullane is a Labour MP
articles.ai_summary:
- Labour MP Margaret Mullane attributes the rising welfare budget to escalating rents charged by landlords.  
- She calls for reforms to address the financial strain on tenants and reduce reliance on government assistance.

articles.title: Traitors winner says high rent makes it tough for first time buyers
articles.summary: Winning The Traitors doesn't mean you can afford to buy a home...
articles.ai_summary:
- The winner of TV show "The Traitors" highlights that high rental costs hinder first-time buyers from entering the property market.  
- Despite their newfound fame, securing a home remains a significant financial challenge.

articles.title: Quick buy firm targets landlords quitting rental sector
articles.summary: The initiative follows the Renters Rights Act triggering many landlords to quit
articles.ai_summary:
- Quick buy firms are seizing the opportunity as many landlords exit the rental market due to the Renters Rights Act.  
- The trend highlights a shifting landscape in UK property, with increasing pressures prompting landlords to reconsider their investments.

articles.title: Landlords to pay £11,713 bill per property to meet EPC rules
articles.summary: This is according to Landlord Trends research from Pegasus Insight
articles.ai_summary:
- Landlords face an average cost of £11,713 per property to comply with new Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) regulations.
- The financial burden stems from research by Pegasus Insight, highlighting rising expenses in the rental market.

articles.title: Renters Rights Act has no effect so far, claims agent
articles.ai_summary:
- A leading estate agent, Foxtons, reports that the recently enacted Renters Rights Act has yet to make any significant impact on the rental market.
- Despite the anticipated changes, landlords and tenants are experiencing little to no difference in their rental agreements and conditions.

articles.title: Five lettings agency myths blown out of the water – apparently
articles.ai_summary:
- Lomond debunks five common myths about lettings agencies, challenging industry misconceptions.  
- The findings highlight the evolving landscape of property management and the importance of accurate information for landlords and tenants.

articles.title: Renters Rights Act worsening affordability crisis – claim
articles.summary: The advice is given by one of the UK's leading lettings agency experts
articles.ai_summary:
- Experts warn that the Renters Rights Act is exacerbating the UK's affordability crisis for tenants.  
- Leading lettings agency professionals highlight potential negative impacts on rental prices and availability.

articles.title: Labour set to miss key house building target
articles.summary: The analysis has been undertaken by the agency and property consultancy Savills
articles.ai_summary:
- Labour is projected to fall short of its critical house-building target, as revealed by analysis from Savills.  
- The findings highlight potential challenges for the government's housing strategy amid ongoing property market pressures.

articles.title: Right To Rent code slammed for being too complex
articles.summary: The call for clarity has come from Propertymark
articles.ai_summary:
- Propertymark criticizes the Right To Rent code for its excessive complexity, urging for clearer guidelines.
- The organization emphasizes the need for straightforward regulations to enhance understanding and compliance in the rental market.

articles.title: Renters Rights Act training sessions at landmark 100th show
articles.summary: It's in London on July 8, and entrance is free
articles.ai_summary:
- Landmark 100th Renters Rights Act training session set for July 8 in London, offering valuable insights for tenants.  
- Admission is free, making it accessible for all renters looking to understand their rights better.
